_about: 100STYLE (Mason, Starke, Komura et al. 2022, Zenodo 8127870, CC BY 4.0 - credit the dataset) motion capture onto a UE5 Manny-conformant game rig. Takes per style: FW/FR forward walk/run, BW/BR backward, SW/SR sidestep, ID idle, TR1 transitions; 60 fps BVH, 23 joints, no fingers (use hands: relaxed). --library 100style=<folder of one style, e.g. 100STYLE/Neutral>. Clip `range` [start, end] seconds cuts a window from a long take.
_clips: Motion-matching database takes: whole takes, root motion with facing (root_motion: facing) so the database knows each frame's trajectory. With a character that turns to face its movement, forward walk/run, idle and the transitions take (starts, stops, turns) are enough; BW/BR/SW/SR are for strafing.
